title: QL-1.05 The sensitive-path gate runs in CI from a workflow the pull request cannot change
request: Closes quality-loop principle 7 in CI. Split from QL-1.03 at its three-round stop (lead decision under the owner's delegation, 31 October 2026): QL-1.03 keeps the local gate, the checklist format and the push hook; this contract runs the gate on every pull request and every push to main from a workflow the pull request cannot change, and refuses a release tag whose commit is not on main. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: QL-1.03. Quality-loop principle set of 30 October 2026 (owner's order: implement as a gate for all dev). Sensitive path (CI workflows): the QL-1.03 checklist applies before merge.

tasks.title: The gate's own workflow, judged by the base
requirements: .github/workflows/sensitive-gate.yml is a workflow of its own that runs scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.mjs on every pull request, into any branch, and on every push to main; it has no paths or paths-ignore filter, so a pull request that touches any file is judged

for pull requests it is triggered by pull_request_target, so GitHub takes the workflow from the base branch and a pull request cannot change the judge; its activity types are opened, synchronize, reopened and edited, so retargeting a pull request to another base runs the gate again on the same head

the gate job checks out the commit it judges with, with persist-credentials: false and fetch-depth: 0, fetches the pull request head by its sha without checking it out, and passes that sha to the gate as --head, so the head is only ever read as data through the gate's own git calls; for a pull request into main that commit is the base sha, for a pull request into any other branch it is main's tip (a base branch that carries a weakened gate judges nothing), and for a push to main it is github.event.before, judging github.sha

no step of the gate job runs npm, runs node on a file from the pull request or runs any file the pull request adds or changes; every step before the gate step is actions/checkout, actions/setup-node or git config; the gate step sets GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 and an empty NODE_OPTIONS, so a replace ref or an injected module cannot change what it reads or runs; the workflow's permissions are contents: read

the gate step runs with bash -eo pipefail, takes the base and the head from the event through env, carries no continue-on-error and no ||, and exits non-zero naming why when the judging checkout has no scripts/gate/sensitive-paths.mjs or the base sha is absent from the clone; the head's copy of the gate is never used in CI, because QL-1.03 brings the gate onto main before this workflow exists
the gate job and its steps carry no if:, the job carries no continue-on-error, and pushes to main are never cancelled by a later run (cancel-in-progress applies to pull requests only)
.github/workflows/release.yml checks out with fetch-depth: 0 and, before any build step, refuses with a non-zero exit a v* tag whose commit is not an ancestor of origin/main

docs/DEVELOPING.md names the gate job of sensitive-gate.yml as the status that must be required on main, a repository setting the owner turns on, and says why the workflow uses pull_request_target and runs nothing from the pull request

the gate job has exactly one actions/checkout step, whose ref evaluates as requirement 3 says for each event and never to the pull request head, and the gate step's argv carries --head equal to pull_request.head.sha (github.sha for a push); a test that reads the workflow keeps every child of a with: block
no step's run text holds a ${{ }} expression, so no event field reaches bash as code; the base and the head arrive only through env

sensitive-gate.yml has exactly one job, the gate job, with no needs:; the gate step is its last step, and every step is actions/checkout with no path, actions/setup-node with no cache, a run made only of git config commands, or the gate step

the gate's concurrency group for a push to main is keyed on github.ref and github.sha and shares no group with ci.yml or release.yml, so no later run, push or pull request, cancels or replaces a push run's verdict

docs/DEVELOPING.md names the two cases CI cannot refuse, a push to main whose own commit rewrites the gate step and a v* tag on an off-main commit whose release.yml drops the ancestry step, and the repository settings that refuse them: main accepts changes only through pull requests, with no one exempt from that rule, and a tag ruleset restricts creating and moving v* tags; turning them on is the owner's act

docs/DEVELOPING.md requires, beside the gate status, that a branch be up to date with main before it merges, and says why: the verdict holds for one base sha and pull_request_target does not run again when main moves; the gate names a checklist bound against an older base as stale
GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 is shown to matter by a fixture in which a replace ref on the head commit, or on a head blob, would change the gate's verdict

each red-green criterion of this task that runs test/gate-sensitive-ci.test.mjs has its own subtest whose name starts with <task>-cNN: (NN is the criterion's position in this task, so T1-c01: for the first), and the criterion runs only that subtest

criteria.statement: Parse .github/workflows/sensitive-gate.yml and assert: on: has pull_request_target with the types opened, synchronize, reopened and edited, and push with branches [main]; neither has paths or paths-ignore; permissions is contents: read; the gate job and its steps have no if: and no continue-on-error; the checkout step has persist-credentials: false and fetch-depth: 0; every step before the gate step uses actions/checkout, actions/setup-node or git config; no step runs npm; the gate step's env sets GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS to 1 and NODE_OPTIONS to empty, and its shell is bash -eo pipefail {0} or its run block starts with set -o pipefail.

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
